The camera begins in an elegant medium shot that establishes the palace interior while keeping the characters prominent. Use a realistic 50mm-equivalent lens, natural depth of field, and smooth physical camera movement.

The camera follows her with a gentle continuous pan, keeping her body, wings, hair, gloves, and costume visible until she completely exits. Do not make her disappear, dissolve, teleport, or vanish behind an invisible transition.

From 00:09.300 to 00:10.200, the camera smoothly returns to <Subject 2>, who remains in the palace holding the bouquet close to her chest. From 00:10.200 to 00:11.600, the camera performs a fast variable-speed optical zoom toward <Subject 2>: quick acceleration, smooth deceleration, and a stable final close-up.

From 00:11.600 to 00:12.000, <Subject 2> looks directly into the lens, tilts her head slightly, smiles mischievously, and gives one clear playful wink with a single eye while keeping the other eye open. Hold the final close-up without cutting.
